title: Evidence Manifest
description: Logical schema for dataset/evidence_manifest.yaml. The YAML file uses a deliberately restricted subset (flat records, inline lists) so it can be parsed with the Python standard library; this JSON Schema documents the same structure for tooling that prefers JSON Schema validation.

id.description: Stable evidence identifier, e.g. LOG-APP-001, PAY-METRIC-003, REL-001.

source_file.description: Path, relative to the repository root, of the underlying data or document.

description.description: What this evidence bucket contains and, where useful, what it does and does not establish.

record_count.description: Number of raw records tagged with this evidence_id. Null for derived aggregates or non-tabular narrative documents.
